assessments.summary: Ebola cases are emerging in Kenya and Nigeria, with WHO reporting three Disease Outbreak News reports in the last 45 days.
Dengue cases in the US have surged 533% over the past eight months, with 1,202 cases reported this year.
Measles cases in the US have surged 232% over the past eight months, with 4,628 cases reported this year.
Global flu test positivity has risen 16% from the previous month, with US hospital admissions up 76% over the past month.
West Nile virus cases in the US have surged 1,762% over the past eight months, with 1,611 cases reported this year.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US have increased 79% over the past eight months, with 7,692 cases reported this year.
Whooping cough cases in the US have increased 48% over the past eight months, with 12,054 cases reported this year.
Malaria cases in the US have increased 59% over the past eight months, with 1,130 cases reported this year.
Marburg virus disease activity is falling, with Wikipedia readership at the 66th percentile of the past year.
Mpox cases in the US are rising, with 41 reported per week (up 47% from 8 months ago), but activity remains baseline.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are rising slightly, with 4,626 cases reported in the week ending 2026-10-31 (up 10% from the previous month), but activity remains baseline.
Global RSV test positivity is rising, with 2% reported for the week ending 2026-10-19 (up 42% from the previous month), but activity remains baseline.
Chikungunya cases in the US are stable, with 6 reported per week (down 7% from 8 months ago), but activity remains baseline.
Avian influenza (bird flu) activity is stable, with Wikipedia readership at the 38th percentile of the past year.
Meningococcal meningitis cases in the US are rising, with 7 reported per week (up 14% from 8 months ago), but activity remains baseline.
